title: The threshold has to go inside the guard's condition instead
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
10 match {
  case n if (n is Number and n >= 3) -> "big"
  case n is Number -> "num"
  else -> "other"
}

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
10 match {
  case n if (n is Number and n >= 3) -> "big"
  case n is Number -> "num"
  else -> "other"
}

explanation.approach: `is` works fine as a plain boolean check inside a guard's `(...)`. Listed first, this guard gets a chance to run before the broader `is Number` case below it.
